svg.title: Concept C, The Survey Chart
svg.text: SURVEY CHART OF A PAYMENT NETWORK · SHEET 1
Positions by payment distance, not geography. Shoals gather where merchants are short of cover;
currents are inferred dependencies; lights mark the keystones.
Chart 1. Shoal tints are contours of how far merchants fall short of cover, smoothed; currents are heavier where more of a shortfall passes on.
m0070 never receives ₹53.05 L from m0008, due at hour 19.
Dashed: settlement routes of the recommended plan, to two keystones already short of cover.
First constraint is a point estimate; no interval.
Delay before the money lands: a scenario parameter, not a production timing.
At 48 h nothing is kept on time, yet 20.9 % of the disruption is cut: payments still late, but less late (97 % of it).
Across the 8 benchmark scenarios with a plan: 17.4 % [5.4, 30.7] at 0 h, 7.9 % [2.6, 15.7] at 48 h, as chosen.
Synthetic network. Every figure is replayed offline inside the synthetic generator; ₹ are analytic rupees; the disruption index is unitless.
